not_found.name: Unknown
description: Unable to find the requested vigilante talent.

combat_skill.name: Combat Skill
description: ::ab{title="&L&Combat Skill (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains any one ‹main/combat feat› as a bonus feat. He must meet the prerequisites for this feat, but he is treated as though he had a number of fighter levels equal to half his vigilante level for the purpose of qualifying for this feat." special="This talent can be selected more than once, but each time the avenger must select a different feat."}

fist_of_the_avenger.name: Fist of the Avenger
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fist of the Avenger (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-boost ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike› as a bonus feat, if he doesn't have this feat already. In addition, whenever he successfully attacks with his fist or a gauntlet, he gains a bonus on damage rolls equal to half his vigilante level (minimum +1, maximum of +5)."}

heavy_training.name: Heavy Training
description: ::ab{title="&L&Heavy Training (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-boost ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Heavy Armor Proficiency› as a bonus feat, if he does not have that feat already. The ‹vigtalent/armor skin› vigilante talent also applies to heavy armor." imp16="If the vigilante has the *armor skin* vigilante talent, he can move at full speed in heavy armor."}

mad_rush.name: Mad Rush
description: ::ab{title="&L&Mad Rush (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee-down ability="Whenever the vigilante ‹rule/charge«s›, he can make a full attack. Whenever he uses this ability, he takes a -4 penalty to his AC until the start of his next turn (in addition to the AC penalty for charging)." prereq="12th-level avenger"}

nothing_can_stop_me.name: Nothing Can Stop Me
description: ::ab{title="&L&Nothing Can Stop Me (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee ability="Once per round, while the vigilante is moving, he can make one attack as a @HLfree_action against an unattended object in the way of his path, such as a door or table. If his attack deals enough damage to destroy the object, he can continue to move. If he doesn't destroy the object, his move ends. This attack is made as part of his @HLmove_action and doesn't count against his attacks this round. If his attack inadvertently targets a creature (such as a ‹monster/mimic›), it automatically misses and his move ends (although he can still attack the creature as normal at the end of his movement)."}

signature_weapon.name: Signature Weapon
description: ::ab{title="&L&Signature Weapon (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante must select one type of weapon (such as longsword or crossbow) when he gains this talent. He gains ‹feat/Weapon Focus› as a bonus feat for his selected weapon type. If he already has the Weapon Focus feat with the selected weapon, he can immediately swap it for another feat for which he qualified at the level he chose Weapon Focus in the selected weapon." imp8="He also gains ‹feat/Weapon Specialization› as a bonus feat for his selected weapon." special="He doesn't have to meet any of the prerequisites for these feats."}

steel_soldier.name: Steel Soldier
description: ::ab{title="&L&Steel Soldier (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-def-boost flavor="Some vigilantes ceaselessly tinker with their armor until the two seem inseparable; ‹arc-vigilante/masked maiden«s› are particularly prone to developing this obsession." ability="The vigilante can spend 1 day and 100 gp per class level modifying a set of armor with which he is proficient. The vigilante can conceal one set of unworn modified armor on his person as though it were an extraordinarily small object, as per ‹skill/Sleight of Hand›, and can ‹rule/don« modified» armor› without aid." special="The ‹vigtalent/armor skin› talent also applies to armor with this ability." imp8="The vigilante treats modified armor's enhancement bonus (if any) as a weapon enhancement bonus when making attacks with the armor's gauntlets, if the armor has any."}

sucker_punch.name: Sucker Punch
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sucker Punch (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="Whenever the vigilante attacks a foe that is unaware of his presence (or who views him as an ally), and the attack deals nonlethal damage, the attack deals an additional 1d6 points of nonlethal damage." incrementPlain="This additional damage~0~6" incrementEnd="d6."}

sweeping_strike.name: Sweeping Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sweeping Strike (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-boost ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Cleave› as a bonus feat." imp6="He gains ‹feat/Great Cleave› as a bonus feat." special="He does not need to meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats." imp12="While using Great Cleave, he no longer has to hit a target in order to make an additional attack against a foe that is adjacent to that target."}

unkillable.name: Unkillable
description: ::ab{title="&L&Unkillable (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-def ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Diehard› as a bonus feat, though he does not have to meet the prerequisites for this feat." imp6="He doesn't lose hit points when he takes a standard action while ‹misc/disabled›." imp12="When he would die from hit point damage, he remains alive for 1 round before dying (and if his hit points rise above a negative amount equal to his Constitution score before that round is over, he doesn't die)." imp18="He is no longer disabled at negative hit points and can take a full round's worth of actions."}

weapon_familiarity.name: Weapon Familiarity
description: ::ab{title="&L&Weapon Familiarity (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante selects either two simple or martial weapons or one exotic weapon when he gains this talent. He gains proficiency with his chosen weapon or weapons." imp8="He also gains ‹feat/Weapon Focus› as a bonus feat for his selected weapon or weapons."}

blind_spot.name: Blind Spot
description: ::ab{title="&L&Blind Spot (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="The vigilante is so skilled at stealth, he can use the Stealth skill to hide from creatures with unusual senses that normally automatically detect creatures. This includes senses such as ‹umr/blindsense›, ‹umr/blindsight›, ‹umr/lifesense›, ‹umr/scent›, or ‹umr/tremorsense›. For each such ability that the creature possesses, if the vigilante is not bypassing the sense in another way - such as the ‹spell/negate aroma› spell for scent or flying for tremorsense - the creature gains a stacking +20 circumstance bonus on all Perception checks to notice the vigilante, rather than automatically noticing the vigilante." prereq="6th-level stalker"}

evasive.name: Evasive
description: ::ab{title="&L&Evasive (Ex)&FN&" icon=def ability="The vigilante is hard to catch with area attacks. He gains the ‹ability/evasion› ability." imp12="He gains the ‹talent/improved evasion› ability"}

hide_in_plain_sight.name: Hide in Plain Sight
description: ::ab{title="&L&Hide in Plain Sight (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante can use Stealth to hide even when being observed. As long as he is within 10 feet of ‹rule/dim light› (his own shadow doesn't count), he can hide without anything to actually hide behind." prereq="8th-level stalker"}

rogue_talent.name: Rogue Talent
description: ::ab{title="&L&Rogue Talent (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains a single ‹ability/rogue talent› (not an advanced talent) of his choice. If he selects a rogue talent that modifies sneak attack, that talent applies to his *hidden strikes* instead of to sneak attacks, and if it has the limitation of only-one-talent-per-attack (a Primary Sneak Attack Talent), it is treated the same as a Hidden Strike Talent (A stalker vigilante can apply only one Hidden Strike Talent to a given *hidden strike,* and only when that *hidden strike* is dealt against a foe that is unaware of the stalker vigilante's presence &#91&or who considers him an ally&#93&, unless otherwise noted)."}

sniper.name: Sniper
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sniper (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="The vigilante can deal *hidden strike* damage with ranged attacks at any distance, rather than within 30 feet." prereq="6th-level stalker"}

stalker_sense.name: Stalker Sense
description: ::ab{title="&L&Stalker Sense (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-def ability="The vigilante has a sense for danger. He always acts on the surprise round." imp6="He gains ‹ability/uncanny dodge›." imp12="He gains ‹ability/improved uncanny dodge›."}

twisting_fear.name: Twisting Fear
description: ::ab{title="&L&Twisting Fear (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="Whenever the vigilante causes an opponent to gain the ‹misc/shaken›, ‹misc/frightened›, or ‹misc/panicked› condition, that opponent takes an amount of nonlethal damage equal to the vigilante's reduced *hidden strike* damage, as the stress wears upon its body." special="A creature can't take damage from *twisting fear* more than once per round. Panicked creatures that take damage from *twisting fear* are too winded even to scream as they flee in terror."}

up_close_and_personal.name: Up Close and Personal
description: ::ab{title="&L&Up Close and Personal (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee swift="When the vigilante attempts an ‹skill/Acrobatics› check to move through an opponent's space during a move action, he can attempt a single melee attack against that opponent. If the Acrobatics check succeeds, this attack applies the vigilante's *hidden strike* damage as if the foe were unaware of the vigilante. Otherwise, the vigilante applies the *hidden strike* damage he would deal if the target were denied its Dexterity bonus to AC." prereq="4th-level stalker"}

foe_collision.name: Foe Collision
description: ::ab{title="&L&Foe Collision (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee flavor="The vigilante can shove one of his foes into another." ability="When the vigilante deals *hidden strike* damage to a corporeal foe with a melee attack, he can also deal an amount of nonlethal damage equal to his reduced *hidden strike* damage to an opponent adjacent to the first (even if the second opponent is out of his reach). The damage is bludgeoning damage, and if the colliding foe has any natural attacks, the damage is also considered magic, evil, or any other type of damage the natural attack deals." special="Unlike normal vigilante talents that affect *hidden strikes,* this vigilante talent applies in all cases when the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC."}

leave_an_opening.name: Leave an Opening
description: ::ab{title="&L&Leave an Opening (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower flavor="The vigilante's *hidden strike* leaves an unbalancing opening in a foe's defenses, setting up the foe to be attacked again." ability="At the beginning of the foe's next turn, if the vigilante threatens the foe, the foe provokes an attack of opportunity from the vigilante. Multiple attacks against the same foe don't create multiple attacks of opportunity in the same round (but attacks against several foes can cause each to provoke one attack of opportunity)."}

mighty_ambush.name: Mighty Ambush
description: ::ab{title="&L&Mighty Ambush (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="Once per round, when the vigilante succeeds at a *hidden strike,* he can instantly drop the damaged enemy ‹misc/unconscious› for 1d4 rounds. A successful Fortitude saving throw negates this effect (DC = 10 + 1/2 the vigilante's class level + the higher of the vigilante's Strength and Dexterity modifiers)." special="Whether or not a creature's saving throw is successful, it can't be affected by that vigilante's *mighty ambush* again for 24 hours." prereq="10th-level stalker"}

throat_jab.name: Throat Jab
description: ::ab{title="&L&Throat Jab (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="The vigilante's *hidden strike* jabs his opponent in the throat, preventing that opponent from speaking until the vigilante's next turn. (If the vigilante uses this ability on the surprise round, it lasts until the end of his first full turn after the surprise round.) This prevents the target from calling out for help, using spells with verbal components, or doing anything else that requires speaking." special="The target cannot be affected by that vigilante's throat jab again for 24 hours." prereq="4th-level stalker"}

animal_patron.name: Animal Patron
description: ::ab{title="&L&Animal Patron (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains the benefits of one ‹class/minor »shifter« aspect› for a number of minutes per day equal to 1 + half his vigilante level. He can shift into this minor aspect as a @HLswift_action." prereq="5th-level vigilante"}

another_day.name: Another Day
description: ::ab{title="&L&Another Day (Ex, Su)&FN&" icon=def ability="When the vigilante is dropped unconscious due to hit point damage, he automatically ‹misc/stabilize«s›, but he can also appear to be dead, unless an examining creature succeeds at a Heal check (DC = 20 + the vigilante's class level) or, if using magic such as ‹spell/deathwatch›, a caster level check with the same DC (the ability to affect spells is supernatural; the rest of the ability is extraordinary)." special="The vigilante counts as having received aid and automatically succeeds at the Constitution check to become conscious after 1 hour (unless he has actually died in the meantime)."}

aquatic_action.name: Aquatic Action
description: ::ab{title="&L&Aquatic Action (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante uses weapons, natural weapons, and unarmed strikes in aquatic environments as though under the effect of ‹spell/freedom of movement›, including when making melee attacks against targets in the water while the vigilante is on land. The vigilante ignores limitations and penalties on ranged attacks, including thrown weapons, imposed by being underwater for the first 15 feet. (See ‹rule/Underwater Combat› for more information.)" prereq="8th-level vigilante"}

armor_skin.name: Armor Skin
description: ::ab{title="&L&Armor Skin (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="The vigilante's armor is like a second skin. He doesn't apply the armor check penalty for light and medium armor on Acrobatics, Escape Artist, or Stealth checks. This penalty applies on other skill checks as normal." imp8="He can move at full speed in medium armor."}

brutal_maneuver.name: Brutal Maneuver
description: ::ab{title="&L&Brutal Maneuver&FN&" icon=melee ability="The first time each round that the vigilante uses a weapon, including a natural attack or unarmed strike, to perform a combat maneuver in place of making an attack (such as by performing a ‹rule/disarm›, ‹rule/sunder›, or ‹rule/trip› combat maneuver in place of making a melee attack), he can choose to take a -5 penalty on all his attack rolls during the round. If he does so and succeeds at his combat maneuver check, the vigilante deals damage to the target of his combat maneuver as if he had hit that target with a normal hit from his weapon."}

chase_master.name: Chase Master
description: ::ab{title="&L&Chase Master (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost flavor="Whether he is the pursuer or the pursued, few can best a vigilante at a chase." passive="He receives a bonus on all checks during ‹rule/a »chase<s› equal to ‹misc/half› his vigilante level or +4, whichever is greater."}

close_the_gap.name: Close the Gap
description: ::ab{title="&L&Close the Gap (Ex)&FN&" icon=def ability="Each round, at the start of his turn, the vigilante can designate one foe within 20 feet that isn't adjacent to him. When he moves, he doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity from that foe as long as he ends his move adjacent to that foe. If he ‹rule/charge«s› that foe, he does not take the -2 penalty to his AC on any attacks made by the designated foe."}

combat_expertise.name: Combat Expertise
description: ::ab{title="&L&Combat Expertise (Ex)&FN&" icon=power order=ap ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Combat Expertise› as a bonus feat, even if he doesn't meet the prerequisites. If he already has Combat Expertise, he instead gains another feat he qualified for at the level when he chose Combat Expertise." passive="If the vigilante's Intelligence score is less than 13, it counts as 13 for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of combat feats."}

concealed_strike.name: Concealed Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Concealed Strike (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="Whenever the vigilante attacks an opponent with a concealed weapon that his target wasn't aware of, he can attempt a Bluff check to ‹rule/feint› that opponent as a @HLmove_action. If he has the ‹feat/Improved Feint› feat, he attempts this check as a @HLfree_action instead." prereq="6th-level vigilante"}

cunning_feint.name: Cunning Feint
description: ::ab{title="&L&Cunning Feint (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-lower ability="The vigilante can ‹rule/feint› as a @HLmove_action or in place of his first attack during a full attack." imp8="When the vigilante successfully feints, the opponent is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC against all attacks until the vigilante's next turn."}

deceitful_trick.name: Deceitful Trick
description: ::ab{title="&L&Deceitful Trick&FN&" icon=melee ability="The vigilante can perform a ‹rule/dirty trick› combat maneuver in place of his first attack during a full attack. He can take a -4 penalty on his check in order to inflict two different conditions on his foe if he succeeds at his check. If the vigilante is successful, the target can remove both conditions as a @HLstandard_action." prereq="‹feat/Greater Dirty Trick›, ‹feat/Improved Dirty Trick›"}

environmental_weapon.name: Environmental Weapon
description: ::ab{title="&L&Environmental Weapon (Ex)&FN&" icon=power order=cw choice="When the vigilante gains this talent, he must select one type of terrain from the ranger's list of ‹ability/favored terrain«s›." swift="While in the chosen terrain, the vigilante can find an ‹misc/improvised weapon<s› if there are any loose or moveable objects around (subject to the GM's discretion). He doesn't take a penalty for using these improvised weapons.~~~For example, if the vigilante selected the urban environment, he might attack a foe with a chair, an empty bottle, or even a door." repeat="The vigilante can select an additional type of terrain.~5~5"}

one_with_the_wild.name: One with the Wild
description: ::ab{title="&L&One with the Wild (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost prereq="‹vigtalent/Environmental weapon›" passive="In the same terrain for which he selected *environmental weapon,* he gains a +4 competence bonus on Stealth, Survival, and Perception checks."}

swamp_concoctions.name: Swamp Concoctions
description: ::ab{title="&L&Swamp Concoctions (Ex)&FN&" icon=power fullround="Twice per day, the vigilante can use the *environmental weapon* vigilante talent to improvise an alchemical weapon worth no more than 15 gp per vigilante level. This improvised weapon cannot be sold and must be used within 3 rounds before it becomes inert.~~~The vigilante gains the benefits of the ‹feat/Throw Anything› feat for the purpose of these improvised weapons. This ability cannot create improvised weapons that incorporate special materials unless those materials are also present." prereq="‹vigtalent/Environmental weapon› (jungle, swamp, or water)"}

expose_weaknesses.name: Expose Weaknesses
description: ::ab{title="&L&Expose Weaknesses (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee ability="The vigilante is able to use sneaky tricks to make it easier to damage a foe, whether it is throwing a bit of fine dust of cold iron over a fey creature or melting a glob of silver onto a lycanthrope's hide. The vigilante can add the ability to reduce a creature's damage reduction or hardness by 10 to the list of options when attempting a ‹rule/dirty trick› combat maneuver check. This does not stack with itself, and it does not work against creatures with DR/&mdash&."}

fantastic_stride.name: Fantastic Stride
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fantastic Stride (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Spring Attack› as a bonus feat, ignoring its prerequisites." repeat="The vigilante can designate one additional creature when he uses Spring Attack; the vigilante's movement this round does not provoke attacks of opportunity from any of the designated secondary creatures.~10~4" prereq="6th-level vigilante"}

favored_maneuver.name: Favored Maneuver
description: ::ab{title="&L&Favored Maneuver (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante selects one type of ‹rule/combat maneuver› to be a *favored maneuver.* He gains the Improved feat corresponding to that combat maneuver (if one exists). He gains a +2 circumstance bonus on combat maneuver checks with that combat maneuver against a foe that is unaware of the vigilante's presence at the start of his combat maneuver." special="A vigilante can select this talent more than once. Each time, it applies to a different combat maneuver."}

gator_wrangle.name: Gator Wrangle
description: ::ab{title="&L&Gator Wrangle (Ex)&FN&" icon=def-boost ability="The vigilante gains a +8 bonus to his CMD against grapple combat maneuvers when using the ‹umr/grab› ability, and he halves all damage from ‹umr/constrict› attacks." passive="When attacking a creature that is grappling him, an avenger vigilante deals an additional amount of damage equal to half his vigilante level." order=ap}

inspired_vigilante.name: Inspired Vigilante
description: ::ab{title="&L&Inspired Vigilante (Ex)&FN&" head icon=power flavor="The vigilante's powers of deduction are far beyond the norm." ability="This ability functions similarly to the ‹class/investigator«'s› *inspiration* ability, but the vigilante's *inspiration pool* is equal to his class level (do not add his Intelligence modifier), the vigilante can never use this ability without expending a use of *inspiration,* and it doesn't count as *inspiration* for any effects that interact with or require the *inspiration* class feature."}

::ab[Inspiration (Ex)]{next icon=boost order=afu flavor="Relevant text from the investigator class ability." usage="You can only use inspiration once per check or roll." ability="You have an inspiration pool equal to ‹misc/half› your level. Your inspiration pool refreshes each day, typically after you get a restful night's sleep." free="You can expend one use of inspiration from your pool to add 1d6 to the result of a check, including any on which you take 10 or 20. This choice is made after the check is rolled and before the results are revealed." special="Using inspiration on attack rolls and saving throws costs two uses of inspiration each time. In the case of saving throws, using inspiration is an @HLimmediate_action."}

instant_plan.name: Instant Plan
description: ::ab{title="&L&Instant Plan (Ex)&FN&" icon=def-protect-boost flavor="The vigilante can quickly manage a situation that seems to be spiraling out of control." ability="Once per day, the vigilante can state a plan of action. All allies within 30 feet that can hear him gain a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects and are immune to being demoralized. They also gain a +1 morale bonus on skill checks or combat maneuver checks of the vigilante's choice. The benefits last for 1 round per vigilante level."}

leap_and_bound.name: Leap and Bound
description: ::ab{title="&L&Leap and Bound (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost-power ability="A vigilante with this talent adds his Strength bonus on ‹skill/Acrobatics› checks in addition to his Dexterity modifier. He is always treated as having a running start when jumping, and his high jumps are treated as long jumps when determining the DC.~~~When the vigilante jumps, he does not fall until the end of his turn, allowing him to attack or perform other actions in midair.~~~If the vigilante grapples a creature capable of bearing his weight, he does not fall, instead remaining adjacent to the creature as it moves." prereq="10th-level vigilante"}

lethal_grace.name: Lethal Grace
description: ::ab{title="&L&Lethal Grace (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-boost order=ap ability="The vigilante combines strength and speed into incredibly deadly attacks. He gains ‹feat/Weapon Finesse› as a bonus feat, and if he already has the Weapon Finesse feat, he can immediately swap it for another feat for which he qualified at the level he chose Weapon Finesse." passive="When using Weapon Finesse to make a melee attack using his Dexterity bonus on attack rolls and his Strength bonus on damage rolls, he also adds half his vigilante level on damage rolls. This bonus damage is not reduced or increased if the vigilante is wielding a weapon two-handed or in an off-hand."}

living_shield.name: Living Shield
description: ::ab{title="&L&Living Shield (Ex)&FN&" icon=def immediate="Whenever the vigilante is grappling a creature and is targeted by an attack, he can attempt a combat maneuver check against the target of his ‹rule/grapple› (this combat maneuver check doesn't count as a grapple combat maneuver check). If he succeeds, the creature he is grappling becomes the new target of the attack. If the check fails, the creature escapes the grapple and the vigilante is the target of the attack as normal." special="This ability must be used after the attack is declared against the vigilante, but before the attack is made and the results revealed."}

magical_familiarity.name: Magical Familiarity
description: ::ab{title="&L&Magical Familiarity (Sp)&FN&" icon=magic flavor="The vigilante taps into a past life's arcane secrets." ability="He selects a 0-level spell from the ‹main/spells_>sorcerer›/‹main/spells_>wizard› spell list. The vigilante can cast the chosen spell three times per day as a spell-like ability, using his vigilante level as his caster level." imp6="He chooses a second 0-level spell that he can also use three times per day as a spell-like ability." imp12="In addition to these 0-level spells, he chooses a 1st-level spell that he can cast once per day as a spell-like ability." imp18="He can cast his 1st-level spell three times per day and his 0-level spells at will." prereq="Intelligence 10+"}

malleable_flesh.name: Malleable Flesh
description: ::ab{title="&L&Malleable Flesh (Su)&FN&" icon=power-magic-down flavor="Whether through mutation or alchemy, some vigilantes have flesh that is as moldable as clay and as fluid as ink." ability="A vigilante with this talent gains the ‹subtype/shapechanger› subtype and the ‹umr/compression› universal monster rule. In addition, the vigilante can alter his appearance as ‹spell/disguise self›, except that the changes are physical rather than illusory. However, aspects of the vigilante's aesthetic persist in all forms, halving the bonus on Disguise checks gained from this effect and from *seamless guise.*" imp12="The vigilante can pass through narrow openings, even mere cracks, along with any item he wears or carries (to a maximum of his light load)."}

minor_magic.name: Minor Magic
description: ::ab{title="&L&Minor Magic (Sp)&FN&" icon=magic choice="A vigilante with this talent selects one of the following spells lists: ‹main/spells_>bard›, ‹main/spells_>cleric›, ‹main/spells_>druid›, ‹main/spells_>psychic›, ‹main/spells_>shaman›, ‹main/spells>sorcerer»/wizard« spell list›, or ‹main/spells_>witch›. Once this decision is made, the selection cannot be changed." ability="The vigilante gains the ability to cast a 0-level spell from the selected spell list. This spell can be cast two times per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this ability is equal to the vigilante's level. The save DC for this spell is equal to 10 + the vigilante's Intelligence modifier (for psychic, sorcerer/wizard, and witch spells), Wisdom (for cleric, druid, and shaman spells), or Charisma (for bard spells)." order=ca}

major_magic.name: Major Magic
description: ::ab{title="&L&Major Magic (Sp)&FN&" icon=magic ability="A vigilante with this talent gains the ability to cast a 1st-level spell drawn from the same spell list as the *minor magic* talent. The vigilante can cast this spell as a spell-like ability a number of times a day equal to ‹misc/one-fourth› of his vigilante level. The caster level for this ability is equal to the vigilante's level. The save DC for this spell is equal to 10 + the vigilante's Intelligence modifier (for psychic, sorcerer/wizard, and witch spells), Wisdom (for cleric, druid, and shaman spells), or Charisma (for bard spells)." prereq="4th-level vigilante, ‹vigtalent/minor magic›, a score of at least 11 in the appropriate ability"}

mockery.name: Mockery
description: ::ab{title="&L&Mockery (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Antagonize› as a bonus feat. He can target a creature with the Intimidate version of Antagonize twice each day, rather than just once." imp12="The effects of the Intimidate version of Antagonize last a number of rounds equal to the vigilante's Charisma modifier (minimum 1)."}

morphic_weaponry.name: Morphic Weaponry
description: ::ab{title="&L&Morphic Weaponry (Ex)&FN&" head icon=power ability="The vigilante can shape his body into weaponry. This acts as the ‹arc-shifter/oozemorph› shifter's *morphic weaponry* ability, treating the vigilante's level as his shifter level." prereq="The ‹subtype/shapechanger› subtype"}

::ab[Morphic Weaponry (Ex)]{flavor="Text from the oozemorph ability." next icon=melee move="An oozemorph can form two primary natural attacks that each deal 1d6 points of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, chosen by the oozemorph when she forms them." swift="An oozemorph can change the damage type of any number of her natural weapons." order=mw repeat="An oozemorph gains an additional primary natural attack.~6~9" special="The total number of natural attacks an oozemorph has at any given time includes those gained via her current form. For example, an 8th-level oozemorph who has taken the form of a wolf with *beast shape I* has a bite attack as part of that form; she can create only two additional natural attacks via *morphic weaponry,* for a total of three attacks available to her at that level. If the oozemorph later reverts to a humanoid form with no natural weapons, she can instead create three *morphic weapons.*"}

perfect_fall.name: Perfect Fall
description: ::ab{title="&L&Perfect Fall (Ex)&FN&" icon=def ability="As long as there is a wall or another surface within arm's reach, the vigilante never takes falling damage. Even if no surface is available, he takes only half damage from falling and lands on his feet."}

perfect_vulnerability.name: Perfect Vulnerability
description: ::ab{title="&L&Perfect Vulnerability (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost standard="The vigilante can cleverly strike his foe where that foe is weakest. This attack targets the foe's touch AC, and the foe is denied her Dexterity bonus against the attack." special="Once a foe has been the target of *perfect vulnerability,* she can't be the target of the same vigilante's perfect vulnerability for 24 hours." prereq="8th-level vigilante"}

poisoner.name: Poisoner
description: ::ab{title="&L&Poisoner (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains the alchemist's ‹ability/poison use› class feature." imp6="When he has 5 doses of a single kind of poison, he can synthesize a dose of that poison once per day at no cost. This process takes 1 minute. It doesn't expend the 5 doses of poison, but the doses must be in the vigilante's possession to perform the synthesis. The poison produced requires careful storage and special skill to use. It becomes inert if it leaves the vigilante's possession and can't be sold. The vigilante can maintain only 1 dose of synthesized poison for every 5 doses of that poison in his possession."}

pull_into_the_shadows.name: Pull into the Shadows
description: ::ab{title="&L&Pull into the Shadows (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee-boost-def fullround="The vigilante can move up to his speed toward an opponent who is unaware of his presence (or who considers him an ally) and make a single attack against that opponent. If the attack hits, he can attempt a ‹rule/drag› combat maneuver against that enemy with a +4 bonus and without provoking an attack of opportunity. If the drag succeeds, the vigilante doesn't need to have enough movement remaining to move with the enemy." special="The vigilante can't use this ability on a true ally or a willing target."}

racial_paragon.name: Racial Paragon
description: ::ab{title="&L&Racial Paragon&FN&" icon=power usage="3 + half his vigilante level times/day (minimum 4)" useF="1~4~2~1~4" useUnit=time move="The vigilante can gain the benefit of a feat with a racial prerequisite he meets but doesn't have. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The vigilante must meet all the feat's prerequisites. The vigilante can use this ability again before the duration expires to replace a previous racial feat with another choice.~~~If a feat temporarily gained in this way has a daily use limitation, any uses of that feat while using this ability count toward that feat's daily limit." special="This vigilante talent can be selected multiple times. Each time it is selected after the first, the vigilante can use this ability to gain the benefits of one additional racial feat at the same time, or to reduce the action required to activate this talent by one step (a move action becomes a @HLswift_action, a swift action becomes a @HLfree_action, and a free action becomes an @HLimmediate_action).~~~If the vigilante chooses to gain the benefits of multiple feats, the feats selected must share the same racial prerequisite. He can use one of these feats to meet a prerequisite of a second feat; doing so means he cannot replace a feat currently fulfilling another's prerequisite without also replacing those feats that require it. Each individual feat selected counts toward his daily uses of this ability."}

returning_weapon.name: Returning Weapon
description: ::ab{title="&L&Returning Weapon (Ex)&FN&" icon=ranged flavor="The vigilante has a signature type of thrown weapon that returns to him." choice="Choose a type of thrown weapon, such as throwing axes." ability="Whenever the vigilante uses the chosen type of weapon, it automatically returns as if it had the ‹magic-enh/returning› property." order=ca imp14="If the vigilante chose a type of thrown weapon that is treated as ammunition, such as ‹eq-weapon/shuriken›, and buys a set of 50 magic ammunition of that type, he automatically replenishes them at no cost and never runs out. If he chose a non-ammunition thrown weapon instead, he can apply the magical properties of the first weapon he throws in a round to any nonmagical thrown weapons of that type he throws that round. This allows him to make a full attack with the benefits of his magical thrown weapon, even though it only returns next round."}

rooftop_infiltrator.name: Rooftop Infiltrator
description: ::ab{title="&L&Rooftop Infiltrator (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains a climb speed equal to half his base speed, which increases to his full base speed when climbing a rope."}

monkeys_paws.name: Monkey's Paws
description: ::ab{title="&L&Monkey's Paws (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-boost ability="The vigilante gains a climb speed equal to his base speed and a +4 competence bonus on ‹skill/Escape Artist› checks." prereq="5th-level vigilante, ‹vigtalent/rooftop infiltrator›"}

shackle_smash.name: Shackle Smash
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shackle Smash (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="Perhaps trained to remove or destroy restraints from slaves and prisoners by the Twilight Talons or ‹rule/Bellflower Network›, a vigilante with this talent can choose to make no more noise than people talking when he attempts a ‹rule/sunder› combat maneuver check or attempts a Strength check to break an object. He ignores half an object's hardness when attempting sunder combat maneuver checks and when attacking nonmagical objects."}

shadows_sight.name: Shadow's Sight
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shadow's Sight (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains low-light vision and darkvision 60 feet. If he already had darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet."}

shadows_speed.name: Shadow's Speed
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shadow's Speed (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="The vigilante's base speed increases by 10 feet." imp10="It increases by an additional 10 feet."}

shield_of_blades.name: Shield of Blades
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shield of Blades (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-def flavor="The vigilante's wild attacks allow him to block his foes' counterattacks." ability="He gains ‹feat/Power Attack› as a bonus feat. If he already has the Power Attack feat, he can immediately swap it for another feat for which he qualified at the level he chose Power Attack.~~~When he takes an attack or full attack action, if he uses Power Attack on every attack to make melee attacks that use his Strength bonus on attack rolls, he gains a shield bonus to his AC until his next turn equal to his penalty on attack rolls from Power Attack. This bonus applies only if he actually takes that penalty on at least one of the attack rolls."}

shield_of_fury.name: Shield of Fury
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shield of Fury (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Improved Shield Bash› as a bonus feat. If he already has the Improved Shield Bash feat, he can immediately swap it for another feat for which he qualified at the level he chose Improved Shield Bash." imp6="He is treated as if he has the ‹feat/Two-Weapon Fighting› feat as long as one of the weapons used is a shield. This allows him to take feats that require Two-Weapon Fighting as a prerequisite without meeting the Two-Weapon Fighting or Dexterity prerequisites, but these feats only apply while he is wielding a shield as one of his weapons (unless he takes Two-Weapon Fighting as normal, in which case this restriction is lifted)."}

signature_arrows.name: Signature Arrows
description: ::ab{title="&L&Signature Arrows (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost-magic order=ca choice="The vigilante must select one type of bow or crossbow (such as ‹eq-weapon/shortbow› or ‹eq-weapon/heavy crossbow›) when he selects this talent." ability="After the first time the vigilante buys a set of 50 pieces of magic ammunition intended for the selected type of bow or crossbow, he can pay the construction cost instead of the purchase price for additional ammunition with identical magical effects for the same weapon, even if he could not normally craft magic ammunition." special="This benefit applies only to the first type of magic ammunition that the vigilante buys 50 pieces of for the designated weapon. The vigilante can take this talent more than once; each time he takes it, he can purchase and gain this benefit with either a specific type of magic ammunition for a different type of bow or crossbow or a different type of magic ammunition for the original weapon." prereq="14th-level vigilante"}

silent_dispatch.name: Silent Dispatch
description: ::ab{title="&L&Silent Dispatch (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="When the vigilante ambushes an enemy or enemies unaware of his presence, he can attempt a Stealth check at a -5 penalty. The result indicates the DC of Perception checks to hear the vigilante's attacks until an opponent's first action, when the DC returns to the normal -10 for hearing battle. Other enemies present can still see the attack; this talent only prevents the sounds of battle from alerting others."}

steely_resolve.name: Steely Resolve
description: ::ab{title="&L&Steely Resolve (Ex)&FN&" icon=power immediate="Three times per day, when the vigilante fails a Will saving throw against a mind-affecting effect, the vigilante can delay the effect's onset for a number of rounds equal to ‹misc/half› his vigilante level, after which the vigilante is affected as normal by the entire effect. Rounds spent delaying the effect do not count toward the effect's duration."}

strike_the_unseen.name: Strike the Unseen
description: ::ab{title="&L&Strike the Unseen (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-boost ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Blind-Fight› as a bonus feat. He can also deal *hidden strike* damage against targets with total concealment." imp10="He gains ‹feat/Improved Blind-Fight› as a bonus feat and can deal all types of ‹misc/precision damage› against targets with ‹rule/concealment› or total concealment." imp16="He gains ‹feat/Greater Blind-Fight› as a bonus feat." special="The vigilante does not have to meet the prerequisites for either Improved Blind-Fight or Greater Blind-Fight to gain these feats with this talent."}

sure_footed.name: Sure-Footed
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sure-Footed (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante can move at full speed while using the Stealth and Acrobatics skills without penalty." imp8="He can move at full speed across ‹rule/difficult terrain›."}

surprise_strike.name: Surprise Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Surprise Strike (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost flavor="The vigilante gains a greater advantage when his foe is unable to defend herself." ability="Whenever he makes an attack against a foe that is denied her Dexterity bonus to AC, he gains a +1 bonus on his attack roll." increment="This bonus~0~8"}

take_em_alive.name: Take 'Em Alive
description: ::ab{title="&L&Take 'Em Alive (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="The vigilante doesn't take the usual -4 penalty on attack rolls made to deal nonlethal damage with weapons that normally deal lethal damage. In addition, the vigilante gains a +1 bonus on all attack and damage rolls for attacks that deal only nonlethal damage and have no secondary effects (such as poison)." increment="This bonus~2~3" incrementMax=15}

team_player.name: Team Player
description: ::ab{title="&L&Team Player (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Swift Aid› as a bonus feat, ignoring its prerequisites. Additionally, the vigilante can use the feat as a @HLstandard_action, in which case it applies to every ally adjacent to the vigilante." imp10="The vigilante can increase the bonus provided to one ally by this feat to +2 by using the ‹rule/aid another<_2› action as a @HLmove_action rather than as a swift action."}

tigers_claws.name: Tiger's Claws
description: ::ab{title="&L&Tiger's Claws (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee ability="The vigilante gains the ability to grow claws similar to a ‹class/shifter«'s›. These claws are ‹umr/natural weapons› that can be extended at will and deal 1d4 points of piercing and slashing damage (1d3 if the vigilante is Small)." imp11="The damage increases to 1d6 (1d4 if Small)."}

turnabout.name: Turnabout
description: ::ab{title="&L&Turnabout (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee flavor="A vigilante with this talent can capitalize on any opportunities in combat." ability="Whenever a foe provokes an attack of opportunity from the vigilante by attacking or casting a spell, the vigilante can attempt a ‹rule/dirty trick› combat maneuver check in place of the attack of opportunity. If he succeeds at the check, in addition to the usual options, the vigilante can redirect the attack or spell to a new target or area the foe could have chosen."}

unexpected_strike.name: Unexpected Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Unexpected Strike (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Quick Draw› as a bonus feat." imp8="He can draw hidden weapons as a @HLswift_action (instead of a move action)."}

vigilantes_reflexes.name: Vigilante's Reflexes
description: ::ab{title="&L&Vigilante's Reflexes (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Combat Reflexes› as a bonus feat. If he already has the Combat Reflexes feat, he instead gains another feat he qualified for at the level when he chose Combat Reflexes." imp8="The number of additional attacks of opportunity per round the vigilante can make increases by 1, regardless of the vigilante's Dexterity bonus." imp16="It increases by 1 again."}

vital_punishment.name: Vital Punishment
description: ::ab{title="&L&Vital Punishment (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-melee ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Vital Strike› as a bonus feat, though he does not have to meet the prerequisites for this feat." ability="Once per round, before he makes an attack of opportunity, he can declare it to be a *vital punishment.* If the attack hits, the vigilante can apply the Vital Strike feat. The vigilante can apply the ‹feat/Improved Vital Strike› or ‹feat/Greater Vital Strike› feat as his *vital punishment* instead if he later gains those feats." prereq="6th-level vigilante"}

volatile_arrows.name: Volatile Arrows
description: ::ab{title="&L&Volatile Arrows (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A vigilante with this talent gains the ability to attach an ‹class/alchemist› bomb to a ranged attack he makes with a bow or crossbow as part of firing the attack. If the attack hits, it deals an additional amount of damage equal to that of an alchemist bomb, using the vigilante's level as his alchemist level to determine the bomb's damage." useMod=Intelligence3 special="The vigilante can takes this talent multiple times. Each time he does, he can use the ability one additional time per day and he gains one ‹ability/alchemist »discovery› that can modify bombs, treating his vigilante level as his alchemist level for any prerequisites. He can apply these discoveries to his bombs as normal." head}

::ab{next title="Bomb (Su)" flavor="Relevant text from the alchemist class ability." icon=zap provokes standard="On a direct hit, your bomb inflicts 1d6 points of fire damage + additional damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (this bonus damage is not multiplied on a critical hit or by using feats such as ‹feat/Vital Strike›)." imp3="The base bomb damage becomes 2d6." imp5="The base bomb damage becomes 3d6." imp7="The base bomb damage becomes 4d6." imp9="The base bomb damage becomes 5d6." imp11="The base bomb damage becomes 6d6." imp13="The base bomb damage becomes 7d6." imp15="The base bomb damage becomes 8d6." imp17="The base bomb damage becomes 9d6." imp19="The base bomb damage becomes 10d6."}

vortex_splash.name: Vortex Splash
description: ::ab{title="&L&Vortex Splash (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee fullround="When in rain or waist deep in water, the vigilante can make a whirling splash, allowing him to attempt a single ‹rule/dirty trick› combat maneuver or ‹rule/feint› against each adjacent foe. The vigilante can make a separate choice for each target."}

whip_of_vengeance.name: Whip of Vengeance
description: ::ab{title="&L&Whip of Vengeance (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The vigilante gains ‹feat/Whip Mastery› as a bonus feat. If he already has the Whip Mastery feat, he can immediately swap it for another feat he qualified for at the level when he chose Whip Mastery." imp6="He also gains the ‹feat/Improved Whip Mastery› feat." special="He treats his vigilante level as his vigilante base attack bonus for the purpose of meeting prerequisites of feats and abilities that have Whip Mastery as a prerequisite."}
